name: Remember Death
source:
This game is a visual novel, so it's basically all reading... with just a few gameplay, if you do not enjoy reading you might not like this game, but giving it a try won't hurt anybody ^^;;

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/631346]Newgrounds[/url]]
